description.text: Starter Set Kaizō (modification) Tapu Bulu-GX, a 60-card deck released on 17 March 2017 with the Islands Await You and Alolan Moonlight expansions. It holds two Tapu Bulu-GX and a combo built for the deck, mixing cards picked from earlier expansions with new ones found only here, and as its name says it was made to be modified with cards from the two expansions. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a rule book and a player's guide came with it.
